description: Na₃CoO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-3.00 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.63 Å. Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.96 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Co atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom.
